en:
## New Features

- Virtual-list mode: Dynamic Spec cards (view tasks / clear / reset), compact markers (open summary / cancel a running compaction) and the reasoning translation toggle are now working controls instead of buttons that did nothing
- A running tool's timeout can now be extended from the virtual list, the same way the classic card allows
- Tool and subagent cards in the virtual list now show their timing breakdown, thinking-effort badge, recent-call durations and the "open full session" button
- Update download and apply failures are now translated instead of always appearing in English

## Bug Fixes

- Fixed "Last message is not a user message" blocking retry when the conversation visibly ended with your own prompt; an interrupted run can leave behind an empty assistant record that nothing draws, and retry now looks through it
- Fixed screenshots turning into tall empty boxes once they were no longer fresh: previews now outlive the hour, fall back to the saved file after a restart, and reserve the same height as an image in a chat message
- Fixed signing in occasionally landing on a blank "Something went wrong!" screen that a reload fixed
- Fixed the search channel order being discarded on every load, which also silently changed which provider was tried first
- Fixed the compact summary dialog pushing its revoke / edit / retry buttons below the fold on long summaries
- Reading search settings no longer rewrites the settings file every time
zh-CN:
## 新功能

- 虚拟列表模式下，Dynamic Spec 卡片（查看任务 / 清空 / 重置）、压缩标记（打开摘要 / 取消进行中的压缩）和推理译文切换现在都能正常工作，不再是点了没反应的按钮
- 虚拟列表中运行中的工具现在可以像经典卡片一样延长超时时间
- 虚拟列表的工具和子代理卡片补上了耗时明细、思考强度标签、最近调用耗时以及「打开完整会话」按钮
- 更新下载和应用失败的提示现在会跟随界面语言，不再固定显示英文

## 修复

- 修复对话明明以自己的提问结尾、重试却报「最后一条不是用户消息」的问题：中断的运行会留下一条界面上看不见的空 assistant 记录，重试现在会跳过它
- 修复截图过一段时间后变成一片空白高框的问题：预览有效期不再只有一小时，重启后会回退到已保存的文件，预留高度也与聊天消息中的图片一致
- 修复登录偶尔跳到空白「Something went wrong!」页面、刷新一下才正常的问题
- 修复搜索通道顺序每次加载都被重置的问题，这同时会悄悄改变优先使用哪个搜索提供商
- 修复摘要较长时，压缩摘要弹窗把撤销 / 编辑 / 重试按钮顶到可视区域之外的问题
- 读取搜索设置不再每次都重写配置文件
